title: I got EXPOSED in Drawback Chess?
summary: Drawback Chess vs online humans; goal 5 wins. Opens by fixing his intro (Lame Duck king can't have left the back rank). G1 Eat Your Vegetables vs opp Simplifier - W; G2 'Stockfish' drawback (can't make the move Stockfish would make) vs opp Irresistible - aborted; G2' Chivalry vs opp Savior Complex - W (lag); G3 (black) Rook on the Seventh vs opp Paranoid - W; G4 Helicopter Parent vs opp Abstinence - W; G5 (black) Savior Complex vs opp Stage Fright - W.
rules: Standard setup and moves; each player is dealt one secret random drawback (card with Easy-Hard difficulty slider); the opponent's drawback is revealed when the game ends ('Your opponent's drawback was ...').
No check/checkmate: kings may move into or stay in attack; capturing the enemy king wins.
Breaking or failing your drawback condition makes you lose (or the move is simply illegal, depending on drawback wording).
Players may chat/rename to bluff or reveal drawbacks.

Drawbacks in this video: Eat Your Vegetables - you can't capture non-pawns until your opponent has only four pawns remaining. Simplifier - if you can capture a piece with a piece of lesser or equal value, you must. (Stockfish) - you can't make the move Stockfish would make. Irresistible - if you can move a piece adjacent to your opponent's king, you must. Chivalry - you can only capture rooks and queens with knights. Savior Complex - when in check, you must move your queen or lose. Rook on the Seventh - by move 15 you must move one of your rooks onto the 7th rank (black: 2nd rank). Paranoid - your king must always be defended (you must be able to recapture on its square) or you lose. Helicopter Parent - you lose if you have an undefended pawn. Abstinence - (text not read). Stage Fright - you can't move to the center four squares.
win_condition: Capture the enemy king. Goal: 5 wins.
